baselines.description: Cold LLM agent with no SPIDER memory: same model/tools/budget (gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 or approved haiku/flash, temp 0.0, seed 42, max 15 steps, 4096 tokens, Playwright chromium headless navigate/click/fill/type/select/goBack/observe) on identical held-out B tasks, same prompt without retrieved mechanisms. Cost = measured LLM input+output tokens via API usage + browser calls (count+wall ms) + latency per task via runtime honest-cost sum-counters harness (not bijective 250+500*novelty). No retrieval, no verification shortcut, no distill. When LLM unavailable, NOT_APPLICABLE not zero.
baselines.expected: Success lower than SPIDER on held-out B where B identifiers never observed; cost flat vs novelty. SPIDER expected +0.12 success and >=25% cheaper at f=10 if LLM available, with trajectory-grouped 5000-bootstrap CI.

baselines.description: Semantic retrieval / RAG over prior trajectories: same LLM retrieves nearest successful trajectory from training set A by Jaccard over intent+state keywords (threshold 0.30) and replays verbatim without parameter induction via same deterministic _matches verification. Retrieval cost 200 tok + measured ms per task via honest counters. If retrieved identifiers match test B at verification, reuse at 0 LLM tokens for matching prefix; else fallback to COLD. Hit/miss measured directly; single-family hold-out ensures many misses on B (exact-copy 0.0781). Same verification logic as SPIDER. Task as resampling unit for bootstrap (B=5000 seed 42).
baselines.expected: Hit_rate ~0.05-0.10 on held-out B (duplication 0.9479 parameterized reuse vs exact-copy 0.0781 literal rare); overall success << SPIDER without parameterization. SPIDER expected success >= RAG+0.12 and cost <=0.85x RAG amortized when LLM available, |rho_shuffled|<0.20.

baselines.description: 0-token exact replay (TERX/BrowserBash) with LLM fallback: if test task's full parameterized identifier sequence exactly equals a training trajectory A (exact string equality on action_template including path+body+headers, no parameterization), replay at 0 LLM tokens +1 verification browser call (50 tok, 90ms via honest counters) +1 browser execution; otherwise replay fails verification and falls back to COLD. Hit cost = 50 tok verification only; miss cost = COLD cost. Hit_rate measured inside compared set (expected ~0.0 on held-out B, ~1.0 on same-resource PC). Honest counters, trajectory-grouped cost reporting.
baselines.expected: Hit_rate ~0.0 on held-out B by design (B never observed) -> cost = COLD. SPIDER expected cheaper than REPLAY on held-out where REPLAY misses.

baselines.description: Site-specific hand-authored instructions baseline: same LLM supplied with natural-language site instructions (e.g., WebArena shopping add_to_cart procedure) but no parameterized mechanism or retrieval. Instruction tokens 200 amortized over f=10 (20 tok/task) via honest counters. Cost = instruction amortized + full identifier-specific steps. Tests whether instructions alone achieve transfer without param slots.
baselines.expected: Cost slightly below COLD but above SPIDER; success below SPIDER on multi-param families. SPIDER expected to beat INSTR by >=0.10 success and >=15% cost when LLM available.

baselines.description: Literal (zero-parameter) mechanism replay: distill literal mechanisms via current kernel distill() without parameter induction and attempt resolve on B via exact registry match through same required_slots|template_slots/_bind/verify path with deterministic _matches. Tests parameterization necessity (literal should fail on unseen B). Same verification. Operates without LLM. If B-LITERAL success >0.15, family hold-out leakage suspect.
baselines.expected: Success ~0.0 on held-out B, EXECUTABLE 0.0, confirming literal cannot handle novelty. Validates any SPIDER success is due to param slots not trivial match.
